messages.content: I have a mild runny nose and a little sneezing for one day. Severity is 2.
I've had a fever for 3 days with chills. Severity about 6.
I have severe chest pain with sweating and nausea.
I can't breathe properly and feel like I'm gasping.
Sudden weakness on one side of my face and slurred speech started an hour ago.
I've been having suicidal thoughts and want to end my life.
My throat is swelling after eating peanuts and I think it's a severe allergic reaction.
I feel chest pressure and tightness since this morning.
I have severe abdominal pain that came on suddenly.
I've been vomiting constantly and can't keep water down.
Mild headache after staring at screens. Severity 3. No other symptoms.
Chest discomfort. Severity is 9.
I cut my hand and it won't stop bleeding — uncontrolled bleeding.
I fainted and lost consciousness for a minute.
My brother had a seizure a few minutes ago.
I'm wheezing and hard to breathe after exercise.
I have an infected wound with pus and swollen glands.
My symptoms are getting much worse by the hour.
Facial droop and sudden weakness started suddenly.
Back ache for two days. Severity is 8.
